payload.reason: The evidence provides multiple instances of evaluating the generalization ability of the NCEL model across various datasets, demonstrating its robustness and effectiveness in entity linking tasks.

claims.text: NCEL demonstrates good generalization ability by consistently outperforming various baselines across five publicly available datasets.
The model's performance on challenging datasets indicates its robustness and generalization ability, particularly in difficult entity linking scenarios.
NCEL achieves the best performance on multiple datasets, showcasing its ability to generalize well compared to other methods that perform variably across datasets.
